title: Lean Review Follow-Up Draft

canonical_node.axiom: A formalization packet is only as strong as its specification quality, not merely its compilation.
definitions: Lean 4.29.1: the specific Lean version used for local build verification.
Rejection-first formalization: a strategy where intended candidates pass only after nearby false positives are shown to fail.
Specification quality: the degree to which definitions are precise, controls are sufficient, and invariants are mathematically meaningful.
derivation: The repository builds locally with Lean 4.29.1.
The formalization uses a rejection-first strategy.
The main review target is ResurrectionFormal/MaxwellTrinity.lean.
The primary concern is specification quality, not compilation.
Therefore, the system should seek external review focused on specification quality.
canonical_node.action: The system should prepare and submit the Lean 4 formalization packet for external review, emphasizing specification quality and requesting feedback on definition strength, false-positive controls, and the mathematical meaningfulness of the scalar-vector coupling invariant.
boundary: Does not claim that the formalization is mathematically correct or that the invariant is meaningful.
Does not assert that external review has been completed or that the packet is accepted.
Does not claim that the formalization proves any physical theorem.
test: Check that the repository builds with Lean 4.29.1.
Verify that the rejection-first strategy is implemented (false positives fail).
Confirm that the review request explicitly asks about specification quality, definition strength, false-positive controls, and invariant meaningfulness.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a structured request for external review focused on specification quality, enabling feedback on definition strength and invariant meaningfulness.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the claim that the repository builds locally and that the formalization is internally canonical.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this document, the follow-up request for external review would be absent, and the distinction between compilation success and specification quality would be lost.

overstatement_risks: May be interpreted as claiming the formalization is correct or that the invariant is meaningful.
May be interpreted as claiming external review has occurred or will occur.
kill_conditions: If the repository does not build with Lean 4.29.1.
If the rejection-first strategy is not actually implemented.
If the review request is not sent or is not focused on specification quality.

plain_summary: This is a draft email requesting external review of a Lean 4 formalization packet, emphasizing that specification quality is the main concern. It does not establish any mathematical or formal claims beyond the local build and internal canonical status.
